import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def contains (t : Node) (key : List Int) : Bool :=
  match key with
  | [] => False -- TST nodes always represent at least one char
  | c :: cs =>
    if c < t.val then
      match t.left with | some l => contains l key | none => False
    else if c > t.val then
      match t.right with | some r => contains r key | none => False
    else -- c == t.val
      match cs with
      | [] => t.is_end
      | _ => match t.mid with | some m => contains m cs | none => False
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def search_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key -- Match Dafny input constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def search (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : search_precond t key) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | none => false
  | some node => contains node key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def search_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Bool)
    (_ : search_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = (key ∈ view_opt t)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp] theorem val_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) :
    (Node.mk v b L M R).val = v := rfl

@[simp] theorem is_end_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) :
    (Node.mk v b L M R).is_end = b := rfl

@[simp] theorem left_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) :
    (Node.mk v b L M R).left = L := rfl

@[simp] theorem mid_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) :
    (Node.mk v b L M R).mid = M := rfl

@[simp] theorem right_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) :
    (Node.mk v b L M R).right = R := rfl

@[simp] theorem view_opt_none : view_opt none = ∅ := rfl

@[simp] theorem view_opt_some (t : Node) : view_opt (some t) = view t := rfl

-- Size lemmas (structural subterm decreases)
theorem size_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l : Node) (M R : Option Node) :
    sizeOf l < sizeOf (Node.mk v b (some l) M R) := by
  simp
  omega

theorem size_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L : Option Node) (m : Node) (R : Option Node) :
    sizeOf m < sizeOf (Node.mk v b L (some m) R) := by
  simp
  omega

theorem size_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M : Option Node) (r : Node) :
    sizeOf r < sizeOf (Node.mk v b L M (some r)) := by
  simp
  omega

-- Unfolding of view
theorem view_mk_eq (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v b L M R) =
      ((view_opt L ∪ view_opt R) ∪ (view_opt M).image (fun s => v :: s)) ∪
        (if b then {[v]} else ∅) := by
  rw [view.eq_def]
  cases L <;> cases M <;> cases R <;> simp

theorem mem_view_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (L M R : Option Node) (key : List Int) :
    key ∈ view (Node.mk v b L M R) ↔
      (((key ∈ view_opt L ∨ key ∈ view_opt R) ∨ (∃ s ∈ view_opt M, v :: s = key)) ∨
        (b = true ∧ key = [v])) := by
  rw [view_mk_eq]
  cases b
  · simp [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
  · simp [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
    first
      | exact or_comm
      | exact Iff.symm or_comm
      | tauto

-- Unfolding of contains
theorem contains_mk (t : Node) (key : List Int) :
    contains t key =
      match key with
      | [] => False
      | c :: cs =>
        if c < t.val then
          match t.left with | some l => contains l key | none => False
        else if c > t.val then
          match t.right with | some r => contains r key | none => False
        else
          match cs with
          | [] => t.is_end
          | _ => match t.mid with | some m => contains m cs | none => False := by
  rw [contains.eq_def]

theorem contains_nil (t : Node) : contains t [] = false := by
  rw [contains_mk]
  first
    | done
    | rfl
    | simp

theorem contains_lt (t : Node) (c : Int) (cs : List Int) (h : c < t.val) :
    contains t (c :: cs) =
      (match t.left with | some l => contains l (c :: cs) | none => False) := by
  rw [contains_mk]
  simp [h]

theorem contains_gt (t : Node) (c : Int) (cs : List Int) (h : t.val < c) :
    contains t (c :: cs) =
      (match t.right with | some r => contains r (c :: cs) | none => False) := by
  have h1 : ¬ (c < t.val) := by omega
  rw [contains_mk]
  simp [h, h1]

theorem contains_eq_nil (t : Node) (c : Int) (h : c = t.val) :
    contains t [c] = t.is_end := by
  rw [contains_mk]
  simp [h]

theorem contains_eq_cons (t : Node) (c c2 : Int) (cs2 : List Int) (h : c = t.val) :
    contains t (c :: c2 :: cs2) =
      (match t.mid with | some m => contains m (c2 :: cs2) | none => False) := by
  rw [contains_mk]
  simp [h]

-- Well-formedness projections
theorem wf_left' {v : Int} {b : Bool} {L M R : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b L M R)) {l : Node} (hl : L = some l) :
    well_formed l ∧ ∀ (c : Int) (cs : List Int), (c :: cs) ∈ view l → c < v := by
  subst hl
  rw [well_formed.eq_def] at h
  refine ⟨h.2.1.1, fun c cs hmem => ?_⟩
  have hx := h.2.1.2.2 (c :: cs) hmem
  exact hx

theorem wf_right' {v : Int} {b : Bool} {L M R : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b L M R)) {r : Node} (hr : R = some r) :
    well_formed r ∧ ∀ (c : Int) (cs : List Int), (c :: cs) ∈ view r → v < c := by
  subst hr
  rw [well_formed.eq_def] at h
  refine ⟨h.2.2.1.1, fun c cs hmem => ?_⟩
  have hx := h.2.2.1.2.2 (c :: cs) hmem
  exact hx

theorem wf_mid' {v : Int} {b : Bool} {L M R : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b L M R)) {m : Node} (hm : M = some m) :
    well_formed m := by
  subst hm
  rw [well_formed.eq_def] at h
  exact h.2.2.2.1

-- The empty list is never in a view
theorem view_nil_not_mem : ∀ (n : Nat) (t : Node), sizeOf t < n → [] ∉ view t := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro t h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨v, b, L, M, R⟩ := t
    rw [mem_view_mk]
    rintro (((hm | hm) | ⟨s, hs, he⟩) | ⟨-, he⟩)
    · cases L with
      | none => simp at hm
      | some l =>
        have h1 := size_left v b l M R
        exact ih l (by omega) hm
    · cases R with
      | none => simp at hm
      | some r =>
        have h1 := size_right v b L M r
        exact ih r (by omega) hm
    · simp at he
    · simp at he

-- Main correctness lemma
theorem contains_iff : ∀ (n : Nat) (t : Node), sizeOf t < n → well_formed t →
    ∀ key : List Int, (contains t key = true ↔ key ∈ view t) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro t h; exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t ht hw key
    obtain ⟨v, b, L, M, R⟩ := t
    have hsizeL : ∀ l, L = some l → sizeOf l < n := by
      intro l hl
      subst hl
      have h1 := size_left v b l M R
      omega
    have hsizeM : ∀ m, M = some m → sizeOf m < n := by
      intro m hm
      subst hm
      have h1 := size_mid v b L m R
      omega
    have hsizeR : ∀ r, R = some r → sizeOf r < n := by
      intro r hr
      subst hr
      have h1 := size_right v b L M r
      omega
    cases key with
    | nil =>
      have h0 : contains (Node.mk v b L M R) [] = false := contains_nil _
      rw [h0]
      simp [view_nil_not_mem (n + 1) (Node.mk v b L M R) ht]
    | cons c cs =>
      have hIL : ∀ l, L = some l → ((contains l (c :: cs) = true) ↔ (c :: cs) ∈ view l) :=
        fun l hl => ih l (hsizeL l hl) (wf_left' hw hl).1 (c :: cs)
      have hIR : ∀ r, R = some r → ((contains r (c :: cs) = true) ↔ (c :: cs) ∈ view r) :=
        fun r hr => ih r (hsizeR r hr) (wf_right' hw hr).1 (c :: cs)
      rw [mem_view_mk]
      by_cases h1 : c < v
      · rw [contains_lt (Node.mk v b L M R) c cs h1]
        simp only [left_mk]
        have eR : ¬ ((c :: cs) ∈ view_opt R) := by
          cases R with
          | none => simp
          | some r =>
            intro hmem
            have h2 := (wf_right' hw rfl).2 c cs hmem
            omega
        have eM : ¬ (∃ s ∈ view_opt M, v :: s = c :: cs) := by
          rintro ⟨s, -, he⟩
          injection he with e1 e2
          omega
        have eD : ¬ (b = true ∧ (c :: cs) = [v]) := by
          rintro ⟨-, he⟩
          injection he with e1 e2
          omega
        constructor
        · intro hc
          refine Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ?_))
          cases L with
          | none => simp at hc
          | some l => exact (hIL l rfl).mp hc
        · rintro (((hm | hm) | hm) | hm)
          · cases L with
            | none => simp at hm
            | some l => exact (hIL l rfl).mpr hm
          · exact absurd hm eR
          · exact absurd hm eM
          · exact absurd hm eD
      · by_cases h2 : v < c
        · rw [contains_gt (Node.mk v b L M R) c cs h2]
          simp only [right_mk]
          have eL : ¬ ((c :: cs) ∈ view_opt L) := by
            cases L with
            | none => simp
            | some l =>
              intro hmem
              have h3 := (wf_left' hw rfl).2 c cs hmem
              omega
          have eM : ¬ (∃ s ∈ view_opt M, v :: s = c :: cs) := by
            rintro ⟨s, -, he⟩
            injection he with e1 e2
            omega
          have eD : ¬ (b = true ∧ (c :: cs) = [v]) := by
            rintro ⟨-, he⟩
            injection he with e1 e2
            omega
          constructor
          · intro hc
            refine Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ?_))
            cases R with
            | none => simp at hc
            | some r => exact (hIR r rfl).mp hc
          · rintro (((hm | hm) | hm) | hm)
            · exact absurd hm eL
            · cases R with
              | none => simp at hm
              | some r => exact (hIR r rfl).mpr hm
            · exact absurd hm eM
            · exact absurd hm eD
        · have hcv : c = v := by omega
          cases cs with
          | nil =>
            rw [contains_eq_nil (Node.mk v b L M R) c hcv]
            simp only [is_end_mk]
            have eL : ¬ ((c :: ([] : List Int)) ∈ view_opt L) := by
              cases L with
              | none => simp
              | some l =>
                intro hmem
                have h3 := (wf_left' hw rfl).2 c [] hmem
                omega
            have eR : ¬ ((c :: ([] : List Int)) ∈ view_opt R) := by
              cases R with
              | none => simp
              | some r =>
                intro hmem
                have h3 := (wf_right' hw rfl).2 c [] hmem
                omega
            have eM : ¬ (∃ s ∈ view_opt M, v :: s = c :: ([] : List Int)) := by
              rintro ⟨s, hs, he⟩
              injection he with e1 e2
              subst e2
              cases M with
              | none => simp at hs
              | some m =>
                have h4 := hsizeM m rfl
                exact view_nil_not_mem (n + 1) m (by omega) hs
            constructor
            · intro hb
              exact Or.inr ⟨hb, by rw [hcv]⟩
            · rintro (((hm | hm) | hm) | ⟨hb, -⟩)
              · exact absurd hm eL
              · exact absurd hm eR
              · exact absurd hm eM
              · exact hb
          | cons c2 cs2 =>
            rw [contains_eq_cons (Node.mk v b L M R) c c2 cs2 hcv]
            simp only [mid_mk]
            have eL : ¬ ((c :: c2 :: cs2) ∈ view_opt L) := by
              cases L with
              | none => simp
              | some l =>
                intro hmem
                have h3 := (wf_left' hw rfl).2 c (c2 :: cs2) hmem
                omega
            have eR : ¬ ((c :: c2 :: cs2) ∈ view_opt R) := by
              cases R with
              | none => simp
              | some r =>
                intro hmem
                have h3 := (wf_right' hw rfl).2 c (c2 :: cs2) hmem
                omega
            have eD : ¬ (b = true ∧ (c :: c2 :: cs2) = [v]) := by
              rintro ⟨-, he⟩
              simp at he
            constructor
            · intro hc
              refine Or.inl (Or.inr ?_)
              cases M with
              | none => simp at hc
              | some m =>
                refine ⟨c2 :: cs2, ?_, by rw [hcv]⟩
                exact (ih m (hsizeM m rfl) (wf_mid' hw rfl) (c2 :: cs2)).mp hc
            · rintro (((hm | hm) | ⟨s, hs, he⟩) | hm)
              · exact absurd hm eL
              · exact absurd hm eR
              · injection he with e1 e2
                subst e2
                cases M with
                | none => simp at hs
                | some m =>
                  exact (ih m (hsizeM m rfl) (wf_mid' hw rfl) (c2 :: cs2)).mpr hs
              · exact absurd hm eD
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem search_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : search_precond t key) :
    search_postcond t key (search t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have h : (search t key h_precond = true) ↔ (key ∈ view_opt t) := by
    cases t with
    | none => simp [search, view_opt]
    | some node =>
      have hwf : well_formed node := h_precond.1.1
      have h2 := contains_iff (sizeOf node + 1) node (by omega) hwf key
      simpa [search, view_opt] using h2
  exact propext h
  -- !benchmark @end proof

import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def contains (t : Node) (key : List Int) : Bool :=
  match key with
  | [] => False -- TST nodes always represent at least one char
  | c :: cs =>
    if c < t.val then
      match t.left with | some l => contains l key | none => False
    else if c > t.val then
      match t.right with | some r => contains r key | none => False
    else -- c == t.val
      match cs with
      | [] => t.is_end
      | _ => match t.mid with | some m => contains m cs | none => False
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry
